notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) ToonFX_Mesh01_FxM: 13 instances, BLEND_Masked (OpacityMaskClipValue 0.3333 in every instance), custom MSM_ToonFX lit shading, one-/two-sided -> template. 33 enabled mesh emitters (SweetRush candies, TrickOrTreat candies/lollipops, TeaSip saucer + shards). EVIDENCE: parameter names identical to MF_Character_Toon_Core / MF_Character_Toon_Rimlight (character toon material); StaticComponentMask defaults Roughness=G, Occlusion=R, Ramp=B, Emissive=A, Metallic=B, ToonBlend=B, IndirectLight=R, RimLightMask=R; MF_RimLight 'Rim light with gradient over horizontal normal direction' (SmoothStep + MakeFloat2 + ramp texture object); T_BluishWhiteGradient viewed (V: white -> black, U: neutral -> bluish); T_Vertical_Line R = centre band, G = complement (rotated + tiled -> candy stripes); DropTrail02 = 3-tone toon waves; t_CloudShadows = cloud mask; Erosion Mask FractalNoiseTile (HasErosionMask is false in every instance). Values cross-checked: MI_Candy_01_Body AlbedoScale 6.359 x ToonLerpScale 0.2 = 1.27 (white stripes on a near-black ToonLerp body) -> lerp(ToonLerp, Albedo*AlbedoScale, mask*ToonLerpScale) order; Candy_02 = pink ToonLerp with lighter stripes. Switch fallbacks equal the root's own defaults (e.g. 'Has Rotate LerpMask texture' False - all 13 instance records carry it, 6 set True). AUTHORED: that lerp order; Rotator angle = param * 0.25 rad (UE Rotator default speed); toon light (hard terminator blended with Lambert by ToonBlendScale, hard Blinn highlight from Roughness/SpecularIntensity/SpecularFalloff); rim r = SmoothStep(Cutoff, Cutoff + 1/Sharpness, pow(1-N.V, Exponent) * Scale) -> Ramp(view normal.x, 1-r) * Tint, added to albedo and x Rim Light Emissive Amount to emission; emission = EmissiveColor * EmissiveTint * EmissiveScale (x Masks.A); erosion mask = pow(N.V, Erosion Edge Fresnel) without an erosion texture, threshold 1 - particle alpha, edge Erosion Mask Softness; dithered CameraDepthFade; particle colour multiplies albedo. NOT REPRODUCIBLE: ToonRamp / RampChannelMinY/MaxY / HasRampChannel (rows of Spellbreak's global toon-ramp atlas, not in the extraction), IndirectShadingScale (directional indirect shading; lab ambient is flat), SmoothnessScale / PBR Roughness (no evidence of wiring), per-instance StaticComponentMask overrides (not exported to materials.json: TeaCup MetallicChannel=R, Popcorn/Staff RoughnessChannel=R, Staff RimLightMaskChannel=A use the root defaults here). KNOWN LIBRARY ISSUES: (1) materials.json stores vectors as {ParameterValue|DefaultValue: [r,g,b,a]} but fx_materials.gd _vec() only accepts arrays, so ToonLerp / EmissiveColor / EmissiveTint / Rim Light Tint overrides do not arrive (root defaults: ToonLerp white, Emissive 0, Tint white) - the candies' colours depend on this fix; (2) only mesh slot 0's material is used (Ms_Candy_01 body, Ms_Candy_02 centre and the lollipop stick render with the slot-0 instance).
